subject: OptimaHealth private deployment — edge gateway preflight & sequencing
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mullins <sarah@optimahealth.com>, Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@optimahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: OptimaHealth private deployment — edge gateway preflight & sequencing

Hi Sarah / Daniel,

Great to meet in the call yesterday — thanks for walking us through the environment. I put together a short preflight plan to make the on-prem + VPC peering handoff as smooth as possible. Attached are: 1) a concise checklist (RI-Optima-preflight-checklist-v1.xlsx) and 2) the network diagram we sketched (optima-network-diagram-draft.pdf).

Top asks from our side to unblock scheduling the install window:
- Confirm the public IP block and whether the edge gateway will NAT outbound (we need the CIDR for firewall allowlist).
- Point of contact for on-site engineering during install (name, mobile).
- Target sequence: VPC peering + private endpoints first, then on-prem appliance bring-up. Can you confirm this order works for your SRE team?
- Any procurement constraints for us shipping the appliance (lead time / receiving POC)?

Proposed timeline:
- Week 1: Network review + config exchange
- Week 2: VPC peering test and private endpoint smoke tests (staging)
- Week 3: On-prem appliance install and acceptance

If that looks reasonable, Monica/Kimberly will coordinate the detailed runbook and schedule. I’ll loop in Aditya for kernel-level tuning notes he flagged.

Thanks — I’d suggest we lock the tentative install window for April 25–27 and adjust if your team needs a different cadence.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128

Attachments: RI-Optima-preflight-checklist-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), optima-network-diagram-draft.pdf (pdf)
From: Sarah Mullins <sarah@optimahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@optimahealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 14:18:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: OptimaHealth private deployment — edge gateway preflight & sequencing

Thanks Marcus — this is helpful. Quick answers:
- We control a /28 public block that can be dedicated for the gateway; I’ll confirm the exact range by EOD tomorrow.
- Daniel Lee will be the on-site POC (mobile: +1 603-555-0199). He’ll be on the install days.
- Sequence sounds good to us — peering then private endpoints, then appliance. Our security team prefers to see peering ACLs before appliance firmware is applied.
- Procurement: appliance purchase is routed through our procurement partner but we can accept vendor shipments to our data center (they need a shipping manifest).

We have an internal maintenance blackout on Apr 26 from 00:00–06:00 UTC; can we avoid that slot if you were aiming for overnight work?

Also tagging two small questions from our SRE:
1) Do you have an expected MTU requirement for the peering link?
2) Will the private endpoints be created in a single AZ or across AZs?

Happy to sync on a 30-minute call tomorrow if useful.

—Sarah
Director, Infrastructure — OptimaHealth
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Apr 2028 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: OptimaHealth private deployment — edge gateway preflight & sequencing

Looping internal owners — below are the items I’ll take point on and notes for the runbook:
- Firewall allowlist: need CIDR and whether edge is NAT-ing. If NAT, we only need egress ports https(443), ssh(22) for support; if not, we need static IPs for token issuance.
- MTU: recommend 1500 by default; if Optima uses jumbo frames we can negotiate 9000 but will need to validate their switches.
- Private endpoints: default is multi-AZ for high availability. For initial acceptance we can target single-AZ in staging and expand to multi-AZ in prod.
- On-prem appliance: shipping manifest template attached (I’ll add to the Drive link). We need serial numbers and MACs before the install to pre-populate the inventory.

Aditya — for kernel/quantization tuning during install, can you prepare the short checklist for our field engineer (CPU pinning, GPU driver version, preferred CUDA/cuDNN pairings)? I’ll add it as an appendix to the runbook.

Marcus — I can draft the detailed day-of timeline once Sarah confirms the CIDR and the blackout window constraint.

Kimberly Park
Infrastructure Program Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mullins <sarah@optimahealth.com>, Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@optimahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Apr 2028 07:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OptimaHealth private deployment — edge gateway preflight & sequencing

Hi Sarah / Daniel — quick update and booking confirmation. Thanks for confirming the blackout window; we’ll schedule the primary install for Apr 25 (day) and a short overnight rollback window on Apr 27 that avoids Apr 26 blackout.

Outstanding items for your team to share before Apr 20: 
- Exact public CIDR for gateway (Sarah)
- Shipping address + receiving POC for appliance (Sarah / Procurement)
- Serial numbers / MACs for appliance (we can accept these on the morning of Apr 25 if that’s easier)
- Confirmation whether Optima will allow MTU=1500 on peering link or needs jumbo frames (Daniel)

Deliverables we’ll share by EOD Apr 19:
- Finalized runbook with minute-level timeline for Apr 25
- Firewall rule diff and peering ACL template
- Aditya’s install checklist for the field engineer

If that timeline works, I’ll send a calendar invite for Apr 25 10:00–16:00 EDT for the install slot and a shorter 22:00–23:30 EDT rollback/recon on Apr 27. Please flag any conflicts.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into production.

Marcus Lin
